summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary POSCO resolved at a board meeting to pay an interim cash dividend of KRW 687 per share, with a record date of June 30, 2026, a provisional payment date of September 10, 2026, and a total cash dividend amount of KRW 66,282,189,375. Since POSCO is wholly owned, the dividend is paid entirely to POSCO Holdings. This is a routine dividend disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
